newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - Hewlett-Packard to buy VeriFone.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - Hewlett-Packard to buy VeriFone.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard said Wednesday it plans to acquire VeriFone Inc in a stock swap valued at $1.18 billion.
Hewlett said VeriFone would be an independent unit of the company.
Under terms of the agreement VeriFone stockholders will receive on Hewlett-Packard share for each Verifone share.
A full text of the company's press release follows.

Hewlett-Packard Company today announced that it will acquire VeriFone, Inc. (NYSE: VFI) in a stock swap valued at $1.18 billion. The proposed acquisition would combine the strengths of HP, the second-largest U.S. based computer company, with those of VeriFone, one of the world's foremost electronic-commerce companies. The stock-for-stock merger is expected to accelerate Internet-based commerce and smart-card applications for financial services institutions, businesses and consumers.
